requirements.text: The calculator shall accept a single arithmetic expression as a command-line argument and print the result.
requirements.source_quote: I want a command-line calculator that accepts one arithmetic expression as an argument and prints the result.

requirements.text: The calculator shall support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/) operations.
